title: fxv upgrade --check payload
description: Payload schema for the `fxv upgrade --check` command's JSON output.

channel.description: The release channel queried for the upgrade check.

compatible.description: True if target_version is below all registered compatibility ceilings.

max_version.description: Lowest compatibility ceiling (exclusive upper bound) among conflicting integrations, if any.

min_version.description: Highest minimum required version (inclusive lower bound) among conflicting integrations, if any.

warning.description: Formatted compatibility warning text, if any.
